bodyType.note: Launch coverage calls it the 'G6 SUV'. PakWheels' spec table lists body type 'Crossover'.

driveType.note: Rear-wheel drive on the Standard Range RWD (PKR 14.5M, the row's priceMin) and Long Range RWD. The top Performance AWD (PKR 18.5M, the row's priceMax) is all-wheel drive.

lengthMm.note: 4758 x 1920 x 1650 mm, same for all three Pakistan variants.

wheelbaseMm.note: 2890 mm for all variants (also on gari.pk's Long Range RWD page).

bootCapacityL.note: Boot space 571 L for all variants (gari.pk Long Range RWD page also 571 L).

kerbWeightKg.note: 2025 kg for Standard Range RWD and Long Range RWD; Performance AWD 2130 kg.

dcChargingMinutes.note: 'Fast charge time (10-80% DC): 12 min' on all variants. No peak DC kW listed.

acChargingHours.note: Home charge (0-100%) 7.9 h for the Standard Range RWD (68.5 kWh, matching the row's battery); 9.7 h for the 80.8 kWh Long Range and Performance AWD. AC onboard charger 11 kW.

batteryTech.note: Battery type 'Lithium-ion' on all variants; chemistry (LFP/NMC) not stated by a Pakistan source.

distributor.note: 'The launch is being orchestrated by Tesla Industries.' Same wording as the X9 row.

availability.value: Sold new in Pakistan by Tesla Industries since the 23 January 2026 launch, in Standard Range RWD (PKR 14.5M), Long Range RWD (PKR 15.5M) and Performance AWD (PKR 18.5M) trims.
availability.note: Launch on Friday 23 January 2026; trim prices from gari.pk launch coverage and https://www.pakwheels.com/new-cars/xpeng/g6/ (ex-factory).

warranty.value: Battery: 8 years / 160,000 km (PakWheels). Vehicle: not published.
warranty.note: Battery warranty '160,000 km / 8 years' on all variants; no vehicle warranty listed.

conflicts.note: PakWheels lists 68.5 kWh for the Standard Range RWD and 80.8 kWh for Long Range/Performance. Not an official source, so not corrected.

535 km is the Long Range RWD; the Standard Range RWD (68.5 kWh, 248 hp, PKR 14.5M), which the row's battery/power/priceMin describe, is 480 km. No test cycle is stated by any Pakistan source (gari.pk calls the AWD's 510 km NEDC; Europe quotes WLTP), so rangeStandard was left empty. The row also mixes the AWD's 4.1 s 0-100; gari.pk gives 6.6 s for the Long Range RWD.

PakWheels' REEV page lists an AC onboard charger of 6.6 kW (home 0-100% 8.5 h), DC 10-80% 25 min, 240 km electric and 1,000 km combined. The row's notes cite XPeng via ProPakistani for AC 7 or 11 kW. Combined range left empty: ProPakistani's launch article (https://propakistani.pk/2026/10/12/xpeng-launches-pakistans-1st-ultra-fast-charging-reev-with-1100-km-range/) says 'around 1,150 km under the CLTC cycle' in the body but 1,100 km in its headline, and PakWheels says 1,000 km.

conflicts.note: The availability text is out of date: 'XPeng has officially launched the LO3 in Pakistan in two variants: REEV and BEV Long Range.' Not an official XPeng source, so listed here rather than corrected.

variant.note: Single variant listed: 'Xpeng X9 Long Range Pro+ 2WD', PKR 31,500,000 ex-factory.

groundClearanceMm.note: Ground Clearance (mm) 176 (the Hybrid+ sheet says 167 mm).

electricRange.note: MG Pakistan spec sheet for the new HS Super Hybrid (24.7 kWh): 'NEDC Electric Range (km) 135'; the model page says 'electric driving range of up to 135 kms (NEDC)'. 63 km was the previous generation.

acCharging.note: The spec sheet quotes 'Est. 7kW Charge Time (Full Charge) 4 Hours' with a Type 2 connection, so the car accepts 7 kW AC; 3.7 kW has no official source.

conflicts.note: Launch report: 'PKR 10,199,000 for the Super Hybrid variant' (introductory, April 2026). The row's own notes say PKR 10,199,000 too; priceMax/priceDisplay follow the same figure. Not corrected because prices may have moved since (no current official list found).

Left empty. The spec sheet gives engine 105 kW, traction motor 154 kW, combined 220 kW / 350 Nm (220 kW matches the row's 295 hp), but the model page https://mgmotors.com.pk/model/mg-hs-super-hybrid labels 154 kW as 'Maximum Combined power'. Fuel tank 55 L.

lengthMm.note: MG Pakistan 'ALL NEW' HS Hybrid+ spec sheet: 'Length * Width * Height (mm) 4670 * 1890 * 1663'. 4655 was flagged in the notes as approximate.

torque.note: Pakistan ZS EV facelift: 174 hp and '280 Newton-meters (Nm), sent to the front wheels'. Matches the row's 174 hp Essence.

MG Pakistan brochure: 'DC Charging (30%-80%) 35 minutes' (30-80% window, not 10-80%). Model page: '10-80% in around thirty-five minutes' - the two official texts disagree on the window. AC (20%-100%) 5.5 hours.
